paragraphs: I’m John Angelo De Joya, also known as J0hnvexcoder. I build websites and software from Bulacan, Philippines, with a practical interest in what happens beyond the interface.

My work spans frontend and backend development, UI/UX, REST APIs, database integration, administrative interfaces and workflow automation. I focus on practical, maintainable solutions shaped around real requirements.

Client delivery and independent projects inform each other. Contract web development taught me to work to a scope and timeline; my self-hosted environment gives me space to investigate deployment, networking, storage and monitoring. Published case studies distinguish client websites, personal software and browser-local demonstrations so the evidence stays clear.

I’m available for remote freelance projects and technical roles. I can discuss collaboration with teams in the Philippines, the United States, Australia, the United Kingdom, Singapore and other markets. I’m based in the Philippines; these are collaboration locations, not offices.
